mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cs_queue_entry ORDER BY priority_score DESC, enqueue_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cs_queue_entry WHERE skill_group_id = #{skillGroupId}

SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM cs_queue_entry q1 INNER JOIN cs_queue_entry q2 ON q2.session_id = #{sessionId} WHERE (q1.priority_score > q2.priority_score) OR (q1.priority_score = q2.priority_score AND q1.enqueue_at < q2.enqueue_at)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_queue_entry (session_id, customer_id, skill_group_id, vip_level, priority_score, enqueue_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{customerId}, #{skillGroupId}, #{vipLevel}, #{priorityScore}, #{enqueueAt})
